# `{python} h["lead_party"]` are favoured in `{python} h["lead_count"]` of `{python} h["n_races"]` governor's races

::: {.disclosure}
Every number on this page starts from synthetic survey answers: three language models answering as 3,600 real respondents to the Cooperative Election Study. We combine those answers with published polls and past results, then simulate the election `{python} h["n_sims"]` times.
:::

::: {.updated}
Updated `{python} h["updated"]`. The models are asked again every day until 1 November.
:::
